display.purpose: Blackletter page titles and the app wordmark; always with the hard grey text-shadow.

body.purpose: Monospace running text, list items, form values, and labels — the whole product's body voice.

icon.purpose: The Midden Icons OpenType font; single letters map to symbols used as iconography and verbs.

shadows.name: letterpress-grey
shadows.purpose: Signature hard cast shadow on white display headings. Zero blur — a letterpress/8-bit artifact, not elevation.

shadows.name: letterpress-dark
shadows.purpose: Hard shadow variant used on lighter glyphs/controls against pale fills.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/active color and background shifts on links, buttons, and rows.

motion.name: moon-cycle
motion.value: 8 discrete phase frames, ~160ms each (~1.3s loop), JS-driven
motion.purpose: The loading indicator: a Midden Icons moon cycling its eight phases; rests on a static full moon under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square grey slab with dark text for form submits and primary actions; hover lifts the fill to bone grey.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-grey, #7d7e75); color: var(--color-dark, #060a08); font-family: 'Libertinus Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-lightGrey, #b0b2b8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Grey slab rendering a Midden Icons glyph with the hard shadow — reads as an adventure-game verb (settings, logout). Production uses the icon font; the SVG here stands in for render.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Settings"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M4.2 4.2l2.1 2.1M17.7 17.7l2.1 2.1M2 12h3M19 12h3M4.2 19.8l2.1-2.1M17.7 6.3l2.1-2.1"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-grey, #7d7e75); color: var(--color-dark, #060a08); padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; filter: drop-shadow(2px 2px 0 rgba(176,178,184,0.9)); transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: var(--color-lightGrey, #b0b2b8); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark fill, thin grey border, square corners; focus shifts the border to the lightest neutral plus a visible ring (strengthened for WCAG 2.2).
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-dark, #060a08); color: var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); font-family: 'Libertinus Mono', monospace; border: 1px solid var(--color-grey, #7d7e75); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-grey, #7d7e75); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); }

components.name: Dashed Panel Card
components.description: The framed rectangle motif: 2px dashed accent border, transparent fill, square corners.
components.html:
Curate your own recipe book.

Need all your favorite gluten-free breakfasts in one place? Make a list.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 2px dashed var(--color-accent, #4a9d5b); border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); font-family: 'Libertinus Mono', monospace; } .ds-card-title { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Directory Row
components.description: Signature component (AppCard): a dashed-bordered hotspot pairing a glyph, label, description, and trailing chevron; hover washes the row and brightens text — a point-and-click hotspot lighting up.
components.html: ✦NetbookA minimalist notes app, synced to your Midden account.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border: 2px dashed var(--color-accent, #4a9d5b); border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); font-family: 'Libertinus Mono', monospace; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #210130) 20%, transparent); } .ds-row-main { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; } .ds-row-glyph { color: #fff; font-size: 2rem; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--color-grey, #7d7e75); } .ds-row-label { display: block; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-row-desc { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-row-chevron { color: var(--color-accent, #4a9d5b); flex-shrink: 0; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-chevron, .ds-row:hover .ds-row-desc { color: #fff; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Monospace header link, white at rest, brightening to the lightest neutral on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Libertinus Mono', monospace; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Moon-Phase Loader
components.description: The suite's loading indicator and one authored motion moment: a Midden Icons moon cycling its eight lunar phases (glyphs 1-7,0) above a pulsing label. Production uses the icon font; this snippet approximates the moon with CSS so it renders standalone. Reduced motion holds a full moon and stops the pulse.
components.css: .ds-loader { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 32px; font-family: 'Libertinus Mono', monospace; } .ds-loader-moon { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 36% 34%, #eaeef7 0 54%, #8f97a9 55% 100%); filter: drop-shadow(2px 2px 0 var(--color-grey, #7d7e75)); } .ds-loader-label { color: var(--color-lightestGrey, #cfd6ea); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-loader-label { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: One design language serves the whole Midden family — Midden, Canteen, and Netbook draw from a single shared/ui layer and one stylesheet, re-tinted per app through [data-theme] overrides. The world it builds fuses an archaeological dig-site (the midden, excavated and laid out for inspection), a 1990s point-and-click adventure interface (chunky clickable slabs, a glyph font that acts like a verb list, a CRT-terminal calm), and a handmade bulletin (dashed cut-outs pinned to a dark board, deliberately un-slick). Nothing here is Web 2.0 or later: no rounded pills, no soft glass, no gloss. The result is brutalist in spirit but never hostile — near-black grounds, a blackletter gothic display against a monospace body, everything squared-off and framed in dashed excavation tape in the app's single accent. Depth is a hard, zero-blur letterpress shadow, an intentional artifact rather than naturalistic elevation. Information is surfaced, not hidden; density is welcome as long as hierarchy keeps it legible. The one thing this system refuses is the generic SaaS register it is defined against.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black grounds, one saturated accent per theme, no light mode.
Blackletter display + monospace body; no third typeface.
Zero border-radius; dashed borders are the form language.
Hard 2px/2px zero-blur text-shadows as the only depth.
A bespoke Midden Icons glyph font supplies all iconography.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each theme carries exactly one accent. It appears on borders, links, active glyphs, and bullets — never as a large fill. Adding a second accent hue breaks the world.

rules.name: The Dark-Ground Rule
rules.body: Every surface descends from --color-dark. There is no light mode. Earn contrast by lightening text, not by inverting the ground.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Blackletter display, monospace everything-else. There is no third family, ever — and monospace here is the body voice of the whole product, not a code costume.

rules.name: The Hard-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The signature shadow is offset 2px 2px with zero blur. It is a stylistic artifact, not an elevation cue. If a shadow has blur, it does not belong to this system.

rules.name: The Flat-Ground Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only lift is a tonal wash (white/5, primary/20) that appears on hover — never a soft shadow.

rules.name: The Square-Cut Rule
rules.body: No border-radius, anywhere. Forms are cut and framed in dashed tape.

dos: Do keep every corner square (0 radius); the form language is cut, not rounded.
Do delineate with dashed borders in the theme accent — 2px for cards/panels, 4px for structural edges.
Do pair Jacquard 12 display with Libertinus Mono body, and nothing else.
Do use Midden Icons glyphs for all iconography; map single letters to symbols as the existing components do.
Do apply the hard 2px 2px 0 (zero-blur) text-shadow to white display headings as the signature depth.

Do meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA: body/placeholder text >=4.5:1, large text and non-text UI (borders, glyphs used as controls) >=3:1, measured against the active theme's --color-dark. The accent is now AA-text-safe on the dark ground in all three themes — preserve that when retheming.
Do tint secondary text from the neutral ramp (Cold Chalk / Bone Grey); never drop below 4.5:1 with a mid-grey.
Do gate every looping animation behind motion-safe / prefers-reduced-motion, with a static fallback that keeps the meaning — the moon loader rests on a full moon, pulses stop, nothing disappears.
donts: Don't introduce border-radius, blurred drop shadows, gradients, gradient text, or glassmorphism — each breaks the Excavated Console.
Don't use --color-accent as a button background behind white text unless the pair clears 4.5:1; back accent fills with dark text instead.
Don't ship focus:outline-none without an equally visible replacement — WCAG 2.2 (2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured, 2.4.13 Focus Appearance) requires a clear focus indicator.
Don't add a second accent hue to any theme; one accent, used sparingly.
Don't reach for post-2.0 polish (soft shadows, rounded pills, glossy gradients). The aesthetic is deliberately pre-2.0 and handmade.
